title: CLEAR: Structured Specifications for Controllable Long-Horizon ML Research Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2611.06263v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly being used to automate machine learning (ML) research workflows, ranging from code development and experiment execution to research reproduction and scientific discovery. Recent systems demonstrate that LLMs can perform substantial portions of ML research engineering with limited human intervention. These advances suggest a shift from automating individual research tasks toward automating long-horizon workflows that transform research artifacts into executable ML systems. However, ML research engineering remains substantially more difficult than isolated code generation. A research artifact typically specifies a system only implicitly through a mixture of natural-language descriptions, equations, pseudo-code, implementation details, datasets, and evaluation protocols. translated_title: CLEAR：用于可控长时程机器学习研究工程的结构化规范
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体正被越来越多地用于自动化机器学习（ML）研究工作流，涵盖从代码开发、实验执行到研究复现与科学发现等多个环节。近期的系统表明，LLM 能够在有限人工干预下完成机器学习研究工程中的相当大一部分工作。这些进展意味着一种转变：从自动化单个研究任务，走向自动化将研究成果转化为可执行机器学习系统的长时程工作流。然而，机器学习研究工程仍然比孤立的代码生成困难得多。一项研究成果通常只是通过自然语言描述、公式、伪代码、实现细节、数据集和评估协议的混合，以隐式的方式规定一个系统。智能体必须首先推断出预期的计算结构，将其翻译为可执行的组件，并协调这些组件（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了CLEAR结构化规范方法，将隐式定义的研究成果转化为显式、结构化的规格说明，从而实现可控的长时程机器学习研究工程自动化。
en_tdlr: Proposes CLEAR, a structured specification approach that converts implicitly defined research artifacts into explicit structured specifications, enabling controllable automation of long-horizon ML research engineering.
